notes: The Lens gets its identity back. The orb no longer re-themes itself from the wallpaper: it is now a fixed, made object - deep warm ink glass, a machined bezel ring with a groove, one fixed light from the upper-left with a true specular glint, and an always-ember ribbon. The adaptation moved to the socket: the ring it sits in is now a shaded well carved from your actual background, wider than before, with hard contact shading at the seat, a soft cast shadow thrown lower-right, and a rim that brightens on the side facing the light. Same Lens on every wallpaper; a seat that belongs to each one.
